objects/def_501c0ee888dd.json.name: Player
objects/def_501c0ee888dd.json.description: The hero, seen from above: walks in every direction with the arrow keys or WASD (no jumping), with a walk cycle for each way.

objects/def_2e1365594fd1.json.name: Wall
objects/def_2e1365594fd1.json.description: A stone wall tile. Draw rows and columns of them to make rooms and corridors.

objects/def_be6e4acb10b7.json.name: Floor
objects/def_be6e4acb10b7.json.description: A floor tile: only a look, drawn under everything. Paint the inside of rooms with it.

objects/def_01a64ef5486a.json.name: Enemy
objects/def_01a64ef5486a.json.description: A slime that wanders around and hurts on contact.

scripts.name: Hurts on touch
scripts.description: Touching it hurts player (1 health a hit).

objects/def_61b855be6e8e.json.name: Key
objects/def_61b855be6e8e.json.description: A key to pick up. Doors can require it.

objects/def_cb169314aed8.json.name: Door
objects/def_cb169314aed8.json.description: A door in a wall, seen from above: blocks the way until it is opened (by a switch, a key or a rule).

objects/def_429f7007a951.json.name: Switch
objects/def_429f7007a951.json.description: A lever. Press E next to it to flip it. Make it control a door.

objects/def_f3655a9dfa90.json.name: Hazard
objects/def_f3655a9dfa90.json.description: Floor spikes, one tile: damage anything that walks over them.

scripts.name: Hurts on touch
scripts.description: Touching it hurts anything with health (1 health a hit).

objects/def_b015515edc2e.json.name: Teleporter
objects/def_b015515edc2e.json.description: A teleporter pad. Connect two with "teleports to" (each way for a two-way pair): stepping on one puts the player on the other.

objects/def_66286ee933b4.json.name: Goal
objects/def_66286ee933b4.json.description: Stairs down: reaching them wins the level (play goes on to the next level).

objects/def_5f9d187d1df2.json.name: Barrel
objects/def_5f9d187d1df2.json.description: A barrel the player can push, one tile per push (for puzzles); it blocks everything else like a wall.

objects/def_caf4e4beb71f.json.name: Heart
objects/def_caf4e4beb71f.json.description: A heart: picking it up gives back one heart of health (up to the most the player can have). Its look is also the look of the player's hearts on the screen.

objects/def_0cc9833bc487.json.name: Grass
objects/def_0cc9833bc487.json.description: A floor block (grass): its top is the ground.

objects/def_b61c4a161d4e.json.name: Dirt
objects/def_b61c4a161d4e.json.description: A floor block (dirt): its top is the ground.

objects/def_341c25a9285b.json.name: Snow
objects/def_341c25a9285b.json.description: A floor block (snow): its top is the ground.

objects/def_4143dc81777b.json.name: Cobblestone
objects/def_4143dc81777b.json.description: A wall block (cobblestone): one block high, in the way.

objects/def_93a0f56939e6.json.name: Wood
objects/def_93a0f56939e6.json.description: A wall block (wood): one block high, in the way.

objects/def_f8d84e8aa182.json.name: Dark Stone
objects/def_f8d84e8aa182.json.description: A wall block (dark stone): one block high, in the way.

objects/def_b027b07429a2.json.name: Light Stone
objects/def_b027b07429a2.json.description: A wall block (light stone): one block high, in the way.

objects/def_d8688a8f947e.json.name: Ice
objects/def_d8688a8f947e.json.description: A wall block (ice): one block high, in the way.

objects/def_ece2d9b7300e.json.name: Water
objects/def_ece2d9b7300e.json.description: Water at floor height: nothing walks into it.

objects/def_3f4ed5a8abe9.json.name: Lava
objects/def_3f4ed5a8abe9.json.description: Lava at floor height (the magma block): it hurts whatever walks on it.

scripts.name: Hurts on touch
scripts.description: Touching it hurts anything with health (1 health a hit).
